claims.claim: KA-01 identifies prospective v1.2 and the 2026-10-19 Human decision while preserving historical v1.0/v1.1, frozen Kernel v0.1 and NOT_ACTIVATED status.
C.1 limits eligibility to future exact-version, individually Human-opted-in ACTIVE PRIMARY, REPAIR and REMEDIATION RUNs, excluding DIRECT_CANDIDATE, preadmission and terminal work.
The PRIMARY contract preserves original TASK/revision, acceptance, base, scope and complete mapped proof without importing correction authority.
The REPAIR contract binds the exact failed predecessor, immutable current AUTHOR_REPAIR action/scope and original/affected verification, prohibiting authorization replacement and terminal reopening.

The REMEDIATION contract binds the exact CHANGES_REQUIRED REVIEW, authorized outstanding finding or approved causal group, source/scope and affected verification, retaining independent DELTA review and rejecting unauthorized findings.

All three operations require the current RUN's exact selected Executor, live native lease identity/generation and authenticated finite Human consent/profile/resources; prior work grants no inherited permission.

The protocol retains one Runtime scheduler, immutable monotonic C_i/K_i/F_i lineage, single feedback consumption, causal progress, idempotent recovery, proof reuse and exactly one terminal RESULT or FAILURE.

The amendment preserves complete reviewed proof obligations and authenticated original-subject applicability; changed proof conditions require INVALIDATED or UNKNOWN treatment and only authorized fresh proof.

Continuation requires complete, stable, decisive candidate FAIL; STOP clauses reject ERROR/UNKNOWN, flaky, partial or stale observations, authority drift, exhausted bounds, lost leases, duplicate effects, no progress and terminal re-entry.
D.1 sequences separate v1.2 normative publication and implemented/reviewed/published G3 core before G6 per-RUN opt-in, with matched L4 measurement and full conformance afterward.

The text distinguishes prospective per-operation eligibility from historical KA-01 and current V1/V2 behavior, and defines prospective rollback while preserving lineage, Reviewer/Publisher authority and downstream pins.
The commit changes only the authorized KA-01 document, adds no runtime implementation, and explicitly leaves L2-03/L3 engineering and G6 separately gated with production inactive.
